auto_redirect_policy_note: Avoid silent browser-locale or location-based redirects. Visible manual language choice remains available.
delivery_role_note: The selector helps the public reach current official content in a usable language, but it does not overstate what has actually been translated or authorized.
equivalence_policy_note: When equivalent translated content exists, route to the corresponding current page instead of a generic landing page.
language_surface_label: Example State official voter-information language selector
machine_translation_boundary_note: Any machine-translation helper is a convenience layer only and does not replace the current official source or official language-help route.
markup_accessibility_note: Identify page language with HTML lang attributes, mark language links correctly, and test the selector in context for keyboard/screen-reader behavior.
privacy_minimization_note: Avoid retaining raw Accept-Language headers, geolocation guesses, or per-user language preference histories longer than the published policy requires.
selected_content_policy_note: If only selected multilingual content exists for a language, state that explicitly and keep the official help path visible.
